name: Inside The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin

overview: Inside The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin is a companion series hosted by Megan Basham, breaking down what you saw, what you missed, and what it all means, revealing layers of symbolism and ideas that make every episode worth a second watch.
